boundary.description: From the confluence of Manchester Ship Canal and Bridgewater Canal (Stretford and Leigh Branch), SE along the Bridgewater Canal to Park Road. Then S along the Park Road to, and W along the railway, then S along Barton Road, Manor Road, Urmston Lane, Anchorage Road and by a straight line S to River Mersey. W along River Mersey to the point opposite Meadow Road and by a beeline to and N along Lime Tree Close, Stretford Road, Ciss Lane, St Clements Fold (both sides in Our lady and English Martyrs parish). Continuing N along Westbourne Park, Winchester Road, Furness Road, Canterbury Road, Rochester Road, Lostock Road, Romley Road and by a beeline to Kingsway Park, Skye Road (after its junction with Iona Way both sides in Our Lady and English Martyrs parish), then E along Shetland Way and by a beeline to M60 Motorway. W along the Motorway to Manchester Ship Canal and E along the Canal to its confluence with Bridgewater Canal.
